summary_1line: Shuka describes to Ravana the vast monkey army and identifies key warriors including Hanuman, Rama, Lakshmana, Vibhishana, and Sugriva.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman as a child leaps thousands of leagues toward the rising sun, trying to seize it in the sky.
Hanuman stands like an enraged elephant before Lanka, the same hero who once burned the city.
Rama stands beside Lakshmana and Vibhishana before the immense monkey army, facing Lanka across the battlefield.
